name.en: Jiangsu Biopharmaceutical (Suzhou) Industry Specialized Mother Fund
name.local: 江苏省生物医药（苏州）产业专项母基金

strategy.thesis: State-backed mother fund of funds dedicated to Suzhou's biopharma cluster (anchored around BioBAY), deploying RMB6bn into innovative drugs, drug R&D, medical devices, healthcare services and synthetic biology companies, one of three specialized industry funds (RMB13.5bn total) landed by Suzhou Chuangtou Group and Jiangsu Gaotou Group in 2024.

sources.title: 规模135亿元 三支专项基金落户
sources.supports: fund name, size, focus areas, and that it is one of three specialized funds worth RMB13.5bn total
sources.quote: 江苏省生物医药（苏州）产业专项母基金，总规模60亿元，聚焦创新药、医药研发、医疗器械、医疗服务、合成生物学等领域，陪伴创新能力强、发展潜力大的生物医药企业不断成长。

sources.title: 苏州生物医药产业专项母基金拟投子基金对外公示
sources.supports: fund is actively deploying to sub-funds (fund-of-funds structure)
sources.quote: 苏州生物医药产业专项母基金拟投子基金对外公示

strategy.thesis: Spun out of BioBAY (Suzhou's biomedical industry park) as a market-oriented, biomedicine-only VC to seed and demonstrate investable projects for the park; initially concentrated 40-50% of its first fund in BioBAY-resident companies before expanding nationally with Beijing and Shenzhen offices while retaining exclusive focus on biomedicine.

sources.title: 三位顶级投资机构合伙人讲述：BioBAY如何用15年打造资本生态圈？
sources.supports: founding year, rationale, BioBAY-affiliation, biomedicine-only focus, geographic expansion
sources.quote: 成立元生的思路很清楚：当时，园区的政府引导基金...如果以BioBAY为主导，成立一个市场化的VC基金，会起到引导和示范作用

verification_notes: Now invests nationally beyond Suzhou; included here because it was founded by and remains headquartered at BioBAY as the park's flagship market-oriented biomedical VC vehicle.

strategy.thesis: Co-founded by BioBAY and a Suzhou Industrial Park Chinese-capital consortium to provide capital to early- and mid-stage biomedical innovators within the park, complementing Yuansheng Venture Capital in BioBAY's capital ecosystem.

sources.title: BioBAY构建世界一流生物产业生态圈
sources.quote: 2018年，BioBAY与苏州工业园区中方财团共同发起成立了聚明创投。聚明创投在2021年完成了24个项目的28笔投资，投资金额逾6亿元。

name.local: 泰鲲基金（杭州泰格生物医药产业基金）

strategy.thesis: Hangzhou's first city-level biopharma mother fund, jointly launched by CRO leader Tigermed (49% via Hangzhou Tigermed Equity Investment) and Hangzhou state investment platforms (Hangzhou Industrial Investment, Hangzhou High-tech Venture Investment), targeting innovative medical devices, biopharma, healthcare services, healthcare IT, digital therapeutics, smart manufacturing and nutrition/health across all company stages.

sources.title: 200亿元级生物产业基金在杭落地
sources.quote: 200亿元级生物产业基金在杭落地

sources.title: 近百亿大手笔投资生物医药产业基金，泰格医药加码赛道投资
sources.supports: LP structure, sponsor breakdown, sector focus
sources.quote: 泰格股权作为有限合伙人认缴出资98亿元，占比49%；泰珑投资作为普通合伙人和基金管理人认缴出资2亿元；杭州产业投资有限公司、杭州高新创业投资有限公司分别认缴出资50亿元，各占比25%。基金投资方向和领域将主要围绕生命健康产业，重点关注创新型医疗器械、生物医药、医疗服务、医疗信息化、数字疗法、智能制造、营养健康等企业

name.en: Hangzhou Capital Biopharma Achievement Transformation Fund
name.local: 杭州资本生物医药成果转化基金

current_fund.raw: 预期总规模超5亿元（首期2.1亿元）

strategy.thesis: State-owned Hangzhou Capital vehicle (managed by wholly-owned subsidiary Guoshun Investment) that converts local pharma research achievements into commercial ventures; LPs include Hangzhou Chanantou, the Taikun mother fund, listed drugmakers Betta Pharmaceuticals and Huadong Medicine, and the Xihu district industry fund.

sources.title: 杭州资本生物医药成果转化基金组建
sources.supports: fund purpose, manager, LP list, fund size
sources.quote: 由杭州资本发起，杭州资本下属全资子公司国舜投资作为管理人，杭州产投、泰鲲基金、贝达药业、华东医药和西湖区产业基金作为有限合伙人出资，基金预期总规模超5亿元，首期2.1亿元。

name.en: Zhejiang "4+1" Biopharmaceutical and High-End Device Industry Fund
name.local: 浙江省"4+1"生物医药与高端器械产业基金

strategy.thesis: Zhejiang provincial industry fund dedicated to biomedicine and high-end medical devices, anchoring the Qiantang district's 'China Medicine Port' cluster; co-managed by Qiantang Industrial Group's Heda Financial Services (GP) and Zhejiang Jinkong's Jintou Shengyuan (GP).

sources.title: 浙江省"4+1"生物医药与高端器械产业基金
sources.supports: fund size, founding date, GP structure, focus
sources.quote: Total scale of 5 billion yuan; Established in October 2023; concentrates on biomedical and high-end medical device investments

sources.title: 省"4+1"生物医药与高端器械产业基金推介会顺利举行
sources.publisher: 杭州市钱塘区人民政府
sources.supports: confirms fund exists and is tied to Qiantang district biomedicine cluster
sources.quote: 省"4+1"生物医药与高端器械产业基金推介会顺利举行

name.en: Wuhan Optics Valley Biolake Industry Guide Fund Cluster
name.local: 光谷生物城产业引导基金集群

aum.raw: 总规模31.6亿元（15只引导基金）

strategy.thesis: Cluster of 15 government guide funds seeded by Wuhan East Lake High-tech Development Zone to support biomedical and other strategic emerging industries within Optics Valley Biolake (光谷生物城), a founding-generation biotech park established in 2008, which has since backed 400+ portfolio companies and 20+ overseas listings including Simcere and Kintor Pharmaceutical.

sources.title: 光谷生物城力摘"皇冠上的明珠"
sources.publisher: 武汉市人民政府门户网站
sources.supports: number of guide funds, total scale, number of supported projects
sources.quote: 目前，光谷生物城设立引导基金15只，总规模31.6亿元，支持战略新兴产业项目400多家。

verification_notes: This is an aggregate cluster of 15 separate government guide funds administered by the Optics Valley Biolake park authority rather than a single legal fund entity; individual sub-fund names/sizes not separately disclosed in the source.

aum.raw: 逾10亿元人民币（5支在管私募股权基金，截至2021年8月31日）

strategy.thesis: Optics Valley-based private equity/VC manager jointly founded by Tianfeng Securities and a Wuhan Commerce Group investment platform; over 70% of its portfolio company count and invested capital is concentrated in biomedicine, making it one of Wuhan Biolake's most biomedicine-heavy VC managers.

sources.title: 企业介绍 - 武汉光谷创投私募基金管理有限公司
sources.publisher: 武汉光谷创投私募基金管理有限公司
sources.supports: founding year, founders, AUM, biomedicine share of portfolio
sources.quote: 武汉光谷创投私募基金管理有限公司成立于2011年5月，由天风证券股份有限公司和武汉商贸集团有限公司下属股权投资平台合资成立。截至2021年8月31日，光谷创投在管5支私募股权基金，管理规模逾10亿元人民币。其中生物医药领域项目数量及投资金额占比均超70%。

name.en: Chengdu High-tech Zone Angel Investment Fund ("Golden Panda")
name.local: 成都高新区创业天使投资基金（"金熊猫"创投生态）

strategy.thesis: Chengdu High-tech Zone's non-profit, policy-driven angel mother fund ('Golden Panda' venture ecosystem) that has issued dedicated angel sub-funds for cell & gene therapy and high-end medical devices; biomedical deals made up roughly 20% of its 66 completed angel investments (RMB146M) as of end-2023.

track_record.portfolio_count: 66 angel deals (RMB146M invested) as of Dec 2023, ~20% biomedical

sources.title: 构建天使投资"朋友圈" 成都高新区做优"金熊猫"创投生态
sources.supports: 5-year RMB10bn target, biomedical deal share, existence of CGT and medical-device angel sub-funds
sources.quote: 成都高新区计划五年设立总规模100亿元天使母基金...截至2023年12月，天使基金累计完成66个天使项目投资，投资金额1.46亿元。其中生物医药类项目占比20%。此外，成都高新区天使母基金已发布了细胞与基因治疗、高端医疗器械等天使子基金。

verification_notes: General-purpose Chengdu High-tech Zone angel program spanning multiple tech sectors; included because it operates explicit cell & gene therapy and medical-device dedicated sub-funds.

strategy.thesis: The first mid-western China biopharma M&A fund anchored by a listed 'chain leader' company (Chengdu Xiandao / HitGen), co-founded with Chengdu Kejichuang Investment Group and Chengdu High-tech Cesu Investment Group to roll up companies across pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, small-molecule CDMO, preclinical CRO and drug manufacturing/sales.

sources.title: 首只！蓉创先导并购基金正式成立
sources.supports: fund size, co-founders, that it's the first such M&A fund in mid-western China
sources.quote: 蓉创先导基金在成都高新区正式签约落地，作为中西部地区第一只依托上市链主企业组建的医药并购基金，由成都科技创新投资集团有限公司、成都先导药物开发股份有限公司、成都高新策源投资集团有限公司合作设立...基金规模为20亿元人民币

sources.title: 中西部首只医药并购基金正式设立
sources.publisher: 四川省人民政府国有资产监督管理委员会
sources.supports: confirms fund launch and government backing

name.en: Wuxi Biopharmaceutical Industry Special Mother Fund
name.local: 无锡生物医药产业专项母基金

strategy.thesis: Provincial-municipal co-funded mother fund (25% Jiangsu Provincial Strategic Emerging Industry Mother Fund, 75% Wuxi city) deploying via a 'sub-fund + direct investment' model into innovative drugs, high-end APIs, TCM, cell & gene therapy, medical devices, medical support industries and consumer medical health to build out Wuxi's biopharma supply chain.

sources.title: 无锡90亿母基金来了
sources.supports: fund size, LP structure, investment focus areas
sources.quote: 江苏无锡生物医药产业专项母基金（有限合伙）规模40亿元，由江苏省战略性新兴产业母基金有限公司、锡创投等共同出资设立...主要投向创新药、高端原料药、中药、细胞基因治疗等药物、医疗器械、医疗支持性产业、消费医疗及国民健康质量提升等领域。

name.en: Guangzhou Development Zone Bio-island Fund Cluster
name.local: 广州开发区生物岛基金（高新区集团）

aum.raw: 总认缴规模123亿元（17个子基金）

strategy.thesis: Fund-of-funds cluster run by Guangzhou Development Zone's state investment platform (高新区集团) dedicated to the Guangzhou International Bio-island, comprising 17 sub-funds with RMB12.3bn subscribed capital, prioritizing early-stage, small-ticket, long-duration hard-biotech investments ('投早、投小、投长期、投硬科技').

sources.title: 万亿政府引导基金流向梳理：生物医药能抢到多少
sources.supports: number of sub-funds and total subscribed capital of Guangzhou Bio-island fund cluster
sources.quote: 高新区集团旗下生物岛基金现有17个子基金，总认缴规模123亿元，目前正按照"投早、投小、投长期、投硬科技"的思路，把资金更多投向生物产业初创企业。

name.en: Bio-island Laboratory (Guangdong) Life & Health Industry Investment Fund
name.local: 生物岛实验室（广东）生命健康产业投资基金

strategy.thesis: Joint fund between Guangzhou's Baiyun district (via Guangzhou Financial Holdings, Baiyun Fintech Holdings and Baiyun Industry Investment Group) and Bio-island Laboratory, a Guangdong provincial lab, formed to commercialize seed- and early-stage sci-tech projects spun out of the lab and affiliated research institutes into strategic emerging and future industries including biomedicine.

sources.title: 我区与生物岛实验室合资成立生物岛实验室（广东）生命健康产业投资基金合伙企业
sources.publisher: 广州市白云区人民政府
sources.quote: 我区与生物岛实验室合资成立生物岛实验室（广东）生命健康产业投资基金合伙企业...重点支持生物岛实验室及承接的广州实验室和其他大院、大所的项目，进行关键核心技术攻关、产品国产化替代，促进项目产业化。
